# INTRAVASCULAR CATHETER-ASSOCIATED CANDIDA SPP. INFECTION

## Inpatient

## Remove catheter and Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases.

## Treatment

Refer to candidemia recommendations for antifungal choice and treatment duration
[Candidemia](candidemia)

## _______________________________________________________________________________

## Outpatient

Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.

References:
Mandell chapter: Infections Caused by Percutaneous Intravascular Devices
Mermel et al., Clinical Infectious Diseases 49 (2009)
Up-to-date article: Intravascular catheter-related infection: Epidemiology, pathogenesis, and microbiology
Up-to-date article: Intravascular non-hemodialysis catheter-related infection: Treatment
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU INTRAVAS CATH CANDIDA SPP
